trigger_condition.execution_trigger: Matrix multiplication on fbgemm backend with zero-size reduction dimension
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: At least one matrix operand has zero inner dimension and dtype torch.long on CPU.

root_cause.backend_layer: Backend implementation fails to correctly handle zero-size reduction dimension.

bug_oracle.description: Output contains different values from uninitialized memory.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Generate matrix operands with zero inner dimension while varying outer dimensions, and use integer dtypes.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Create tensors with shapes such as (m,0) @ (0,n) or (0,k) @ (k,n), ensuring at least one zero reduction dimension.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Use torch.long tensors and ensure CPU backend is used.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Invoke torch.matmul or addmm on the constructed zero-inner-dimension integer tensors and repeat execution.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Run the same operation multiple times and compare outputs; inconsistent or non-deterministic results indicate uninitialized memory.
